content.title: About Fourth - Hospitality & Restaurants Solutions
content.text: We Are Fourth Fourth is a leader in data-driven workforce management software and inventory management software for the retail, restaurant, and hospitality sectors. With over 20 years of expertise in data and analytics, Fourth helps you conquer the day with actionable insights and demand forecasting to optimize operations, maximize margins, and empower employees. Today, Fourth is trusted by over 15,000 customers across 100,000 sites globally with 2.5 million users. For press inquiries and information, see our Press Kit page. Our Values Our values signify the key attributes of the behaviors we exhibit in our daily interactions with our team members, customers, partners, and other key stakeholders. They embody our aspirations and goals for successful growth. Adapt & Grow We embrace innovation, agility, and continuous improvement to overcome challenges, achieve our goals, and strive for excellence. Collaboration When we work together with a common purpose, we achieve collective success. Respect Listening with intent to ideas and opinions, we embrace and celebrate differences, empowering people to be their best selves. Fun Sharing passion and excitement for everything we do. Customer Focus We listen to understand our customers, providing them with the best options to achieve their goals. Honesty Authenticity allows us to build trusted relationships. Where there is trust, there is meaning in what we do and who we are. Our Collective Commitment to DEI Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion are close to our hearts at Fourth. We believe that our differences make us stronger and a better reflection of the customers we serve. We are committed to fostering an environment where differences are celebrated and valued, empowering every individual at Fourth. Discover More Caring about our Communities Caring about people is part of our DNA. Our global teams participate in many local outreach and community impact projects, putting the members of our community at the forefront of our agenda. Learn More How our Journey Began Our story began in 1999 with two individual companies on two separate continents with trailblazing entrepreneurs at their helms. Both shared similar goals ─ to streamline restaurant and hotel processes through intelligent technology. Both grew exponentially and became well-recognized brands in the technology sector — Fourth and HotSchedules. Then in July 2019, these two companies merged to fulfill one shared goal as Fourth. Today, Fourth is a leader in data-driven workforce and inventory technology for the retail, restaurant, and hospitality sectors. With over 20 years of expertise in data and analytics, Fourth Intelligence is trusted by over 15,000 customers across 100,000 sites globally with 2.5 million users. And as we continue our founders’ legacy, we are proud to advance the Fourth Industrial Revolution ─ the momentous change in our environment where disruptive technologies and trends will revolutionize how we live, work, and relate to one another. With the Fourth Intelligence Platform, we aim to transform how our customers conquer the day in the increasingly dynamic-paced environment in which they operate. Fourth Leadership Scott CollisonChief Executive Officer Jay AltizerChief Operations Officer Christian BerthelsenChief Technology Officer John WhitmarshChief Financial Officer Curt RichtermeyerChief Revenue Officer Nipul ChokshiChief Marketing Officer Backed by Marlin Equity Partners Marlin Equity Partners is a global investment firm with over $8.5 billion of capital under management and more than 17 years of market experience. They focus on providing stakeholders with solutions that meet their business and financial requirements. Learn More Conquer the Day Save time, reduce costs, and increase profitability with Fourth’s intelligent solutions. Reduce labor costs with accurate demand forecasting that eliminates over and understaffing. Eliminate your HR burden with HR and payroll services that manage it for you. Lower your COGS and drive increased profitability with inventory management solutions. Your information will be processed in accordance with our Privacy Policy.This field is hidden when viewing the formGCLID Chief Executive Officer Scott Collison is Chief Executive Officer of Fourth. He brings a track record of building category-defining products that change how companies operate. Scott has held leadership roles at Microsoft, Salesforce, VMware, and Anaconda, the world’s most popular data science platform. Most recently, Scott was CEO of Personify, where he drove revenue growth and operational improvement that led to a successful acquisition by Momentive. He holds a PhD in Cultural Anthropology and German from UC Berkeley — not the typical résumé line for a tech CEO, but one that shows up in how he leads: listen first, understand how people actually work, and build from there. At Fourth, that means getting closer to the restaurant and hospitality operators who depend on the platform every day, and making sure every product investment translates into real results for operators — stronger revenue, better margins, and simpler operations. Scott is based in Austin, Texas. Chief Operations Officer Jay Altizer joined Fourth as Chief Operating Officer in 2021. Jay has nearly 30 years of experience leading teams in business services, software implementation, strategy, operations, and product management. Most recently, Jay was the President of GES – a global events services provider with $1.15B in sales and 3500 full time employees across North America, the UK, and Europe. Previously, Jay was SVP and General Manager at Dean Foods, where he served large global hospitality customers such as McDonald’s, Sonic, Darden, Chick-fil-A, and Burger King. Jay began his career in professional services at Deloitte, where he led systems implementations for large corporate clients such as CKE Restaurants, Inc. He then spent time at Bain and Company leading strategy, M&A, and transformation efforts for global clients across a variety of industries. He also has extensive private equity experience leading diligence, growth, and operational improvement projects as the founder of Falling Branch Advisors. Jay lives in Dallas with his wife and three children. Chief Technology Officer Christian Berthelsen is Chief Technology Officer of HotSchedules and Fourth. Early in his career Christian developed web applications and inventory control solutions at FnBshop.com, a private SaaS company he co-founded and sold to Fourth in 2003. He has over 21 years of software engineering and management experience, and oversees the product roadmap, development and infrastructure of all our software. Christian enjoys scuba diving, Formula One and trips to his native Copenhagen. Chief Financial Officer Chief Financial Officer John Whitmarsh brings over two decades of financial management expertise to the executive team, having played a pivotal role in growing multiple private equity-backed SaaS and technology companies. Prior to joining the team, John served as the CFO of Vyze, which was recently acquired by MasterCard. Previously, he was the CFO for Zenoss Inc., a provider of unified IT monitoring and management solutions for physical, virtual and cloud-based IT infrastructures. He also held CFO roles at Century Payments (Worldpay), Misys Transactions Services (Allscripts), Digital Motorworks (ADP) and MessageOne (Dell), where he was named 2009 Best CFO for private companies by the Austin Business Journal. He graduated from The University of Texas at Austin and is a licensed CPA in the state of Texas. Chief Revenue Officer Curt Richtermeyer joined Fourth in 2023 as Chief Revenue Officer. With over 30 years of experience building, leading, and managing high-performance sales, services, and operational organizations, Curt is an accomplished leader who has a passion for helping customers leverage technology to unlock high levels of business value and performance. Prior to joining Fourth, Curt held executive positions at SparkCognition, Aurea Software, CallidusCloud (now SAP), Oracle, and Trilogy where he played a pivotal role in building strong customer relationships and long-term partnerships. Curt lives in Austin where he studied philosophy and business at the University of Texas at Austin for both undergraduate and graduate degrees. Chief Marketing Officer Nipul Chokshi is a B2B SaaS marketing executive with 15+ years building demand engines and revenue-aligned marketing organizations. Prior to joining Fourth, he has held senior marketing and strategy roles at large established brands as well as startups – Dun & Bradstreet, Microsoft, Yammer, and Marketo. At Fourth, he leads global marketing with a focus on pipeline and bookings growth, brand, competitive positioning, and customer retention
